description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) ADAMANTINE TERROR (Ironclad Champions, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_active (P1 Space Marines ACTIVE vs P2 Orks, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Entering the Fight phase opens fight_phase_start for the active Space Marines player; ADAMANTINE TERROR is offered on the Redemptor Dreadnought (DREADNOUGHT, engaged with the Meganobz); a real click spends 1 CP; each enemy unit engaged with it (the Meganobz) makes a battle-shock roll with -1 (Game Log names the dice, the -1 and the result).
